newsitem.title: USA: Major oils play catch-up with broader market.
newsitem.headline: Major oils play catch-up with broader market.

text.p: Major oil stocks played catch-up with the rest of the market ofter underperforming yesterday.

"It is just sector rotation, oil could not be more flat than they are today. We have had a pretty good rally in S&P today and oils are a major part of that," said Michael Young, analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Exxon Corp was up 1-3/4 at 61-7/8, Mobil Corp up 2-7/8 at 142, Chevron Corp added 1/4 at 73-1/8, ARCO up 1-3/4 at 149, Unocal Corp up 3/4 at 42-3/4 and Texaco Inc up 1-3/8 at 110-7/8.
The S&P 500 was up 11.42 at 854.84 by 1202 EDT.

Schroder Wertheim analyst Michael Mayer said that attitudes among investors at the margins were changing on oil stocks after projections that oil prices would slide to $15-$16 a barrel by the end of the second quarter turned out not to be true.
West Texas Intermediate crude blend for July delivery was trading at $19.40 per barrel. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
